title: Self-regulatory mechanisms of anammox system in response to CuO NPs revealed by microbial ecological networks and metagenomics
description: Explore the microbial mechanisms in an anaerobic ammonium oxidation (anammox) system under the influence of copper oxide nanoparticles, and analyze the changes in gene abundance related to nitrogen metabolism, protein metabolism, and polysaccharide metabolism, as well as the interactions between microorganisms.
